name: topk-tie-breakers
description: Cover multi-column ORDER BY, mixed direction and offset without arbitrary order

queries.name: amount-desc-id
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 25

queries.name: amount-page-two
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 25

queries.name: quantity-asc-id-desc
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, quantity FROM events ORDER BY quantity ASC, event_id DESC LIMIT 30

queries.name: filtered-topk
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 15
